body: This PR updates the compat to allow ClimaTimeSteppers v1 to be used. This PR also clean up the compat and `src` since `ClimaTimeSteppers` was both a dependency and an extra and `ClimaTimeSteppers` was imported but not used in `Schedules`.
title: Update compat to allow ClimaTimeSteppers v1

body: This PR make a release of ClimaDiagnostics v0.3.10. This is needed to update the downstream packages such as ClimaAtmos and ClimaLand to make nightly AMIP run.
title: Release v0.3.10
